english: Wow, this outfit's cute…
Why not try it on?
D-do I look okay? Isn't it weird?
Yeah, it's cuuute!
You're not lying? Really?
It's true! Right, [CLAUDE]-kun?
(Tell her a beautiful girl looks good in anything)
B-beautiful girls look good in anything.
Beautiful girl? Does she mean me?\nBeing told that by a boy…\nit's the first time…!
You're not lying?\nThis isn't a prank, right?
Charles-chan should be more confident.\nThe other customers are looking at you too?
Maybe they think\na boy came in?
That's not it.\nLook at their eyes. They're gazes of admiration,\nright, Haruka-san?
Yeah! I'm admiring you too~!
Uuuh… I feel like crying…
She's this cute, so\nwhy would anyone think\nof making her act like a boy?
It's not my place to say,\nbut the IS development race\nmust drive people that mad.
That aside, is there an outfit\nHibiki wants to try?
Me? I usually wear my uniform,\nso I don't really do fashion…
A uniform, hmm?\n…Clarissa! It's me!\nAny good ideas… hmm, I see…
I hear Japan has idol costumes\nthat are dressed-up uniforms.\nI'll buy you one.
Huh!? That's okay, really…
Would you prefer a wedding dress?
I'm only 15! And isn't that\nleaping way too far!?
Fufu, that was a joke, of course.
Geez, you surprised me…\nBut it's the first time I've seen\nLaura-chan laugh like that.
I-is that so…
Okay, then Laura-chan will wear\na deco uniform too!
Me too?
If we match, I'll wear one!
It wouldn't suit me!
Then I won't wear one either?
Mmm… is this the Japanese tradition\nof being under one's wife's thumb…
//Fade to black\n//Background: Akihabara\n//Rika, Eve, and Koto accompany Satoko's junk hunt
Dejiko-san told me, but Akihabara has lots of\nshops selling shady things once you go\ninto the back alleys.
It's a totally different vibe from the main street, it is.
Yeah, might be a bit early\nfor you shorties?
Not at all! Tiny cameras, radios,\nlistening devices— things you can't\nget in Hinamizawa…!
Just looking at them makes my trap-making\ncreativity bubble up… Fufufu…
Satoko-chan, you really love this stuff.\nI'm more interested in that curry place\nover there.
I'm more of a foodie too, I am.\nNipah☆
Whether it's tools or food,\nI'll buy you whatever you like.
Eve-san, are you that rich?
I haven't been flying around worlds\nlonger than you for nothing?\nI've built up assets.
Wow! Then I'll take you up on that—\none regular curry and one dry curry!
The drinks look tasty too, they do.
I can't decide what to buy!
//Fade to black\n//Background: main street (or Akihabara)\n//Tsubasa and [MERU] or [NOEL] head to that AKB theater
I'm looking forward to it, Tsubasa-san!
A permanent idol theater—\nsurprising.
You're curious after all?
Yes. Watching a show from another world\nshould be educational.
I'm watching the rookie idols in\nthe opening act!
I'd love a girl after my own heart— one who\nseems like she'll sell but doesn't, yet steadily\ngains core fans!
[MERU]\nwatches the fine details.\nDo you love idols that much?
Actually, I wanted to be\na magical idol. But I failed\nthe singing test…
So even if they're not stars, I want to cheer on\ngirls who stand on the idol stage\nand do their best.
True, those who can see can tell the difference\nbetween a kid just going through the motions\nand one who's serious.
I think an idol is someone who tries their hardest,\neven if their singing and dancing aren't top-class.\nI wanna see a girl I can't help but cheer for!
I hope you find one.\n…By the way, is the theater this way?
Huh? I just followed because Tsubasa-san\nwas walking so confidently…?
Huh? Could it be, Tsubasa-san…?
Ah—…
Daily idol shows—\nthis town's got everything!
When I heard there was a permanent idol theater,\nI was surprised.
Tsubasa-san the singer obviously,\nbut as a magician,\nI absolutely have to see it too!
Yes. Watching a show from another world\nshould be educational.
Standing before people and performing every day\nmust be so stimulating!
I've done street performances too,\nbut a place with real props and equipment\nis a different quality!
([NOEL]'s magic is most amazing\nwhen done mid-battle, though…)
Basking in applause feels great!\nIt's addictive.
Yes. The moment you feel your expression\nreach the audience is wonderful.
You think so hard about how to reach them more.\nAnd when it's no good,\nyou get super down.
Still, if even one customer wants you,\nyou can keep going.
Yeah!
…By the way, is the theater this way?
Huh? Tsubasa-san, you know the way, right?\nI'm directionally challenged?
Huh? Could it be you too, Tsubasa-san…?
(nods)
Ah, uh, in times like these!\nExcuse mee! Does anyone know\nwhere the theater is—!
//Fade to black\n//Background: town (night)
Shopping was fun!
Didn't buy much, though.
It can't be helped.\nWe're practically wanderers;\nwe can't carry more luggage.
Hmm, this is troubling…
What's wrong?
Have you seen Haruka-san?
Come to think of it, Haruka-chan's gone.
She got too excited and wandered off, no doubt.
I'll go look for her.
//Fade to black\n//Background: park (if available)
Huh—? Where'd everyone go?\nAnd where is this???
Maybe I'll rest on the park bench a bit…
Stop it, please!
Just one photo, what's the harm!?
…Persistent.
Hm?
I said no.\nDid you not hear me?
Don't be like that!\nI'm just adding one photo\nto my beautiful-girl collection!
Enough! If that's how it is…!
I'm begging you here, come on!\nBetter than getting secretly photographed!
Heeey! You there!\nDon't bother girls!!
//Haruka runs over.
You're…!
(Minazuki… Haruka…!)
Forcing something on someone who doesn't want it— you're disqualified as a boy!
Who are you? Don't get in my way!\nOr will you satisfy me instead?
S-satisfy you, huh?\nO-okay! Then!
Um, excuse me…?
It's fine! Leave it to me!
How will you satisfy me?\nCome on, show me!
Here I go! First, this—!!!
//Event art: striped-panty debate
Th-this is… striped panties!? Why are striped panties\nsuddenly coming out of your pocket!?
Do you like striped panties?
Of course I do! I love them!
Okay! Then, show me yours?
Huh?
Hm? You call yourself a striped-panty-ist,\nso of course you carry them around, right?
Huh!? Striped panties are something you carry around…?
Oh, are you wearing them?\nI see— that'd be embarrassing~.
(This one's hopeless, I gotta do something fast)
Here's a question.\nWhy keep striped panties on hand at all times?
T-to put them on someone…?
Hmm, close! That's not bad,\nbut the truth lies elsewhere.
Then why…?
Mental focus… emptying the mind…\na key item for reaching enlightenment…
Huh!?
Someone once said: "When in trouble,\ncount the stripes on the striped panties"…
The number of stripes on the striped panties\nyou hold now is a special number only you know.\nA mystical number that gives you courage…
Look! These are my striped panties! You don't know\nhow many stripes there are… which means I'M the one\nwith the mental advantage!
Wh… what…!?
//Add a "gogogogogo…" SE if available.
I'm an otaku too… I understand the relationship\nbetween knowledge and courage backed by\noverwhelming confidence, that power…!!
The moment I, of all people, realize "I can't beat\nthis person" is the moment I should run!!
My senses are normal! They're working!!\nSo running away is neither shame nor defeat!\nIt's justice! The right choice!!
//The otaku runs off.
…What is this.
Phew, did that work?
Ah… thank you\nfor saving me.
Glad to hear. Um…?
I'm Tesla Violet.\nAnd this is my little sister…
Nain…
Tesla-chan and Nain-chan, huh.\nI'm Minazuki Haruka. Nice to meetcha.
You really saved us.\nHe wouldn't leave us alone.
No problem. Glad nothing happened~.
Yes, right after coming back\nfrom Italy… I'm exhausted~.
You came from Italy? Um, that's the country\nwith the pizza tower, right?
Pizza…?
Do you mean the Leaning Tower of Pisa?
Ah! That's it!\nIf it were a pizza tower, the birdies\nwould eat it.
Fufu, Minazuki-san, you're funny.
Ehehe, y-you think?
Sis…
Oh, that's right, Natchan.\nMinazuki, would you care to\njoin us for some tea?
My treat, of course—\nto thank you for helping us.
I-I couldn't, really~. But hmm,\nI haven't had anything sweet lately~…\nI want a strawberry cream chocolate-sauce parfait~.
Hee hee, seconds are fine too.
Huh? Ahaha, I won't eat that much~.\n…Probably.
Then shall we head to the café?
Ah! That's right,\nI was looking for everyone…
Huh?
Sorry, I gotta go!\nSee you later, Tesura, Nine~!
// Haruka runs off.
Minazuki's… gone…
Sis…
She didn't seem to notice\nwho we really are.
I was hoping to find out\nwhether she's a Twin Angel, but…
!! Sis, this…!
// Event CG: Nine picking up the Poketen
…Natchan, is that Minazuki's?
…She dropped it.
I sense a strange power…\nIf this is what the Twin Angels need\nto transform…
If Haruka's a Twin Angel…\nshe can't transform?
// Event CG off
That would follow.\nLet's test it.
Understood.
// Fade to black\n// Background: Akihabara (night)
Where could Haruka have gone?
// Haruka arrives.
Ah, there you are!\nAoi-chaaan!
Haruka! Thank goodness,\nI was worried, you know?
Ehehe, sorry sorry.\nLet's head back to everyone…
Kyaaa!!
A scream!?
It came from down this street!
It's a monster!\nThat's no cosplay! Run!!
Aoi!
Right! Let's transform!
Yeah! …H-huh… wha—?
What's wrong?
It's gone… gone!\nIt's nowhere!! My Poketen's gone!
Whaaat!?
I can't transform into a Twin Angel!
// Battle map: Akihabara (night)\n// Twin Angels and Dejiko cannot sortie
In a populated area like this…\nWhat are they planning, I wonder!
And I was right in the middle\nof browsing the shops!
Dejiko's busy remodeling her shop, but\nwhat happened to the Twin Angels?
Aoi went looking for Haruka\nand never came back.
We'll just have to handle this ourselves!
Then I'll just rampage twice as hard!!\nCurry power—ten times the energy!!
// Battle start\n// Chris appears after a set number of turns
You bastards! What the hell are you doing!!\nDo you even know where you are!
Huh?
Hey, miss! It's dangerous here!
That's 'cause you bastards are blasting away!
That voice… no way!?
// Chris transformation movie\n// Chris appears
You bastardsss!!
Singing? Then that means— a Symphogear!?
Chris!!
Yukine…!!
Hibiki! Tsubasa!\nYou pulled a real dirty trick on me last time!!\nI won't fall for it again!!
Huh!? Dirty trick? What are you talking about?
Shut up! Don't tell me you forgot!
Wait, what are you even saying…
Shut your mouth!\nYou're all filthy, every last one of you!\nI only trust myself! That's what I decided!
Eat this!!
// Chris attacks Hibiki.
Ugh!! Stop it, Chris!\nWhat's gotten into you!?
Acting all soft to get close…!\nHeh! Not gonna happen!!
Chris!
Don't go fighting in the middle of town!\nI'll smash every last one of 'em myself!\nOraaaaaaaaah!!
She's lost her cool…\nTachibana! Let's cool her head off!
Understood!
// Event triggers when Chris and Hibiki engage
Come on! I owe you one—\nand I'm paying it back in full!!
What debt!? I don't remember any!
Don't play dumb!!\nI haven't forgotten the pain\nof getting punched in the face!
I don't remember anything about\npunching Chris in the face!!
// Event triggers when Chris and Tsubasa engage
Stand down, Yukine!
You sheath YOUR sword!\nThen I'll riddle you full of holes, no mercy!!
What's wrong with you…\nthis isn't like you!
That's MY line!!\nKazanari Tsubasa pulling a sneak attack—\ncolor me impressed!!
You think I'd do something like that?
Cut the goody-two-shoes act!!\nI'll rip that mask right off!!
// Event triggers when Chris and Koto engage
Remember me?\nThis is our second round!!
Still not dead, huh, Hammer Girl!
If I'm Hammer Girl, you're Barrage Girl!
Heh! Then I'll make you Swiss-Cheese Girl!
// Event triggers when Chris is defeated
Dammit!! Again…!\nI lost again!!
Wait! Something's wrong!\nThe last time I fought Chris\nwas a loong time ago…
Shut up! I won't believe a word you say!!\nThe fact that you tricked me and tried to crush me\nwon't be erased by words!!
The scars and pain carved into this body!\nYou can't take those back!! Never!!
// Chris vanishes
Chris!!
She vanished… Laura, that was…?
Yeah. Probably the same as when I used\nthe little box I had.
I wonder if we could get our hands on that?\nI'm itching to study it!
// Battle ends when all enemies are defeated\n// Background: Akihabara (night)
Chris… why…?
Don't let it get you down.\nThanks to Yukine, we've learned a few things.
She said she fought Hibiki and Tsubasa~.
Could she be one of those lookalikes~\nthat Remu was researching—\na doppelganger~?
We hadn't seen her lately, but\nthere was that shady blackish one, right?\nIt looked like somebody, y'know.
Right—when I came to Akihabara once\nwith Soniko, I fought a small black one,\nand it looked like Dejiko.
Come to think of it, there was a fake Shirayuki too!\nMaybe that Barrage Girl fought\none of those things?
But still—to be so completely convinced\nit's the real thing, like that girl was…\nisn't that going a bit far?
A Symphogear is a relic—\nit can't be replicated. And hearing our songs,\nof course she'd think it was real.
Could something like that really happen?\nSomeone besides me singing my song,\nwielding a Symphogear that shouldn't exist…
Yukine sang and fought beside us—\nshe's our comrade. I couldn't mistake her song.
You're right.\nBut if she really did fight\nsomeone like that, I can understand how she feels.
More mysteries have piled up, but\nthey're surely mysteries we must solve.
We'll put our heads together\nand solve it, won't we!
Thank you, Rika, Satoko.\nNo time to sit around moping!
Mhm. That's my bride, all right.
By the way, where are Haruka and Aoi?
// Haruka and Aoi come running.
Heeey, everyooone!
I'm sorry, I couldn't get\nthe Twin Angels to come.
Glad you're both safe.\nWhat a relief.
So, did something happen\nto the Twin Angels?
Ah, um, well, they weren't\nfeeling too well, it seems…
They always seem so healthy,\nbut everyone has days like that~.
Maybe they caught a cold?\nWell, can't be helped when you're under the weather.
I'm sure they'll come next time,\nso don't worry.
(Aoi…!)
(Let's find the Poketen by then.\nI'll help too.)
(Yeah…)
Come to think of it, I don't see Charles.\nWhere could she be?
Isn't that her over there?
What's that…?
// Event CG: Charles being photographed in Akihabara, dressed as a man
L-like this…?
Look this way too, pleeease.
I'm not a model or anything…
You're a cosplayer, right?\nMan, foreign cosplayers look great\nin anything!
Y-yeah…
Handsome!
Super handsome!!
I'd let him have me!!
That's… not really my thing…
// Event CG off
She's surrounded…
She's making a 'help me' face.
(If they attack, do stop them properly.)
(Surely they wouldn't go that far…)
// Fade to black\n// Background: city (night)\n// Tesura and Nine's conversation
The Twin Angels never showed up,\nas expected.
There's no doubt now.\nThe Twin Angels are Minazuki Haruka\nand Kannazuki Aoi.
But…
Yes—at their age,\nthey couldn't have been involved\nin the fire that burned our home. Which means…
The Twin Angels… aren't our enemy…?
…I have to admit it. But then—\nFather… Black Trader…\nlied to us…?!
I don't understand…\nWho is our real enemy…!?
Father… lied…? No…!
…We don't know anything yet.\nLet's think it over a little more…
…Understood.
//END
